contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN DECEN TIVS PF AVG ; R/ [VICTORIAE] DD NN AVG [ET CAES]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Decentius (350-353), Two Victories issue, possibly Trier mint, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bare headed bust draped right. Obverse inscription: DN DECEN TIVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories holding a shield aloft inscribed VOT / [--]/[--]. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE] DD NN AVG [ET CAES]. In exergue: possibly TRP - part off-flan. Diameter:…
